title: School tomorrow

intro.bo: Is it evening, {nome}? Then let's get things ready for tomorrow. One at a time.
intro.pilu: {nome}, before sleeping let's check everything is ready for tomorrow.
intro.tango: {nome}! School tomorrow! Let's get everything ready now, so tomorrow morning we can dash!

offscreen: Hang the same list, drawn as pictures, by the bedroom door.

items.label: My clothes are on the chair
My snack is in my bag
My cuddly toy is in bed with me

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
